findings.title: Passive vault has no asset withdrawal/execution path
findings.disposition: Permanent passive accumulation vault is intentional. Do not add holder withdrawal/sweep/arbitrary-execute path. Product language must disclose non-withdrawable permanent NFT-bound accumulation semantics.
